summary: Verified Cakupan Kunjungan fix. Backend /api/dashboard/kpi now intersects visited keluarga_ids with registered (non-deleted) keluarga ids and clamps cakupan at 100% (server.py L645-647, L672). 11/11 pytest cases pass against public URL: no-filter returns the expected 127 terdaftar / 122 dikunjungi / 96.1% cakupan; all four kelurahan filters (Selat Hulu 83/80/96.4%, Selat Tengah 30/30/100%, Selat Dalam 7/6/85.7%, Selat Utara 7/6/85.7%) satisfy invariants dikunjungi<=terdaftar and cakupan<=100 with cakupan == round(d/t*100,1). Date range filters (wide and narrow) also hold invariants. Regression: /dashboard/charts, /dashboard/insights, /dashboard/jawaban still 200. Frontend: Admin Dashboard KPI cards render 127 / 122 / 96.1% consistently (screenshot captured).

issues: Still uses browser-native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn Calendar — carried over from iter9, not in scope for this fix.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct and minimal: registered_ids = set(distinct keluarga.id with kelurahan+not-deleted), visited_ids intersected with registered_ids, cakupan clamped with min(..., 100.0). Edge case total_kel==0 returns cakupan=0 (handled).
Minor: distinct() + set-intersection runs in app memory; fine for current scale (hundreds). For >10k keluarga, prefer an aggregation ($lookup) to compute intersection in DB.
server.py still ~1965 lines — split into routers remains outstanding from iter9.
seed_data_creation: None. No test data created or left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cakupan fix verified end-to-end. Dedicated regression test at /app/backend/tests/test_cakupan_fix.py (run: pytest backend/tests/test_cakupan_fix.py -n 0 -v). Expected baseline values 127/122/96.1% are hard-asserted — if seed data changes, loosen that single assertion but keep the invariant checks (dikunjungi<=terdaftar, cakupan<=100).
rca of the issue: Previous iter9 saw cakupan=108.7% because kunjungan.distinct('keluarga_id') included keluarga_ids that were soft-deleted or outside the kelurahan filter, so numerator could exceed denominator. Fix: compute registered_ids first from keluarga collection with deleted!=true (+kelurahan filter), then intersect visited_ids with registered_ids, and defensively cap cakupan via min(..., 100.0).
